note: Grassy riverside campground on the Upper Iowa River at Bluffton, about 12 miles from Decorah, with sites along the bank; a canoe livery. Bought in 2026 by Bluffton Resort & Bar (id 14515), across the river, and being renamed Kenny's Corner. RV reviewers say the river sites are unlevel and the grass gets soft in rain. --Claude
